title: UNCLE ARTIE'S NEXT STEP

repair_lobby.world: Tap the lobby at the bottom of the building.
repair_lobby.panel: Tap Repair Hallway until the lobby reaches 80%.

list_unit.world: Tap the empty unit to put it on the market.
list_unit.panel: Tap List for any tenant, or pick one kind of tenant.

end_month.world: Your unit is listed. Tap End Month to bring in applicants.
end_month.panel: Close this panel, then tap End Month to bring in applicants.

choose_applicant.world: Applicants are waiting. Tap the building's Details button.
choose_applicant.panel: Tap Applications, then Accept the applicant you like.

repair_damage.world: A leak has damaged a unit. Tap the room with the cracked walls.
repair_damage.panel: Tap the repair at the top of the panel until the room is above 30%.

help: Tap any room or the lobby to inspect it; Close returns to the whole building.
Each room's panel leads with its condition, rent and the one thing it needs now.
List empty units, then End Month to collect rent and bring in applicants.
Repair before rooms fall below 40%: residents in poor rooms leave.
People, Money, City and Inbox hold residents, finances, new properties and mail.
Menu (or Esc) saves, loads, changes settings and shows these tips again.
